page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated physical cores, providing 4 vCPUs with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It has a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio provide predictable compute performance for standard workloads without the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators or bundled local storage.

The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes the ecs.g8i.xlarge suitable for general-purpose workloads. These include mid-tier web serving, application servers, microservices, containerized deployments, and development or testing environments that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand high-performance local storage or GPU acceleration.
